No templates found with those criteria maybe need also "aryl amine" etc. Could search for amide bond cleavage: functional_groups_broken: ["amide"], formed: ["acyl chloride","primary amine"]? Let's try reverse: forward reaction breaks amide and forms acyl chloride and amine (hydrolysis). But we want retrosynthesis (break amide). So template would have broken amide. So search with broken "amide".
<thought>Search for templates that break an amide bond (functional_groups_broken: ["amide"]) to generate an acyl chloride and an amine (functional_groups_formed: ["acyl chloride","primary amines"]). This should give a retrosynthetic disconnection for amide formation.</thought>
